cards.text: Saul, king of Israel, has been chasing David, and now he blesses him and heads home (1 Samuel 26:2, 25). But I don't think David's unpacking his bags just yet, friend. He says to himself, "One of these days now I will be swept away by the hand of Saul."

cards.question: David decides there's nothing better for him than to escape. Where does he plan to go?

cards.text: So David takes his six hundred men to Achish son of Maoch, the king of Gath, a Philistine city. They settle there, and every man has his family with him, so that's not a visit, friend, that's a WHOLE town moving in.

cards.question: David's two wives come with him to Gath. One is Ahinoam of Jezreel. Who's the other?
When Saul learns that David has fled to Gath, he stops searching for him.

cards.text: Then David says to Achish, "If I have found favor in your eyes, let me be assigned a place in one of the outlying towns, so I can live there." Friend, that is the most polite way anybody has EVER asked to move out.

cards.question: David gives Achish a reason for wanting to live in one of the outlying towns. What is it?

answers.text: A servant shouldn't live in the royal city with the king
His men need open land for all their flocks
His family can't settle into a crowded city

cards.text: That same day, Achish gives David Ziklag. And Ziklag still belonged to the kings of Judah when this was written.

David lives in Philistine territory a year and four months, and in that time he and his men raid the Geshurites, the Girzites and the Amalekites. These people had lived since ancient times in the land stretching to Shur and Egypt.
This part's heavy, friend. Whenever David attacks a territory, he leaves no man or woman alive.

cards.question: Whenever David attacks a territory, he doesn't come back empty-handed. What does he take?

cards.text: Then he goes back to Achish, who asks him, "What have you raided today?" And David answers, "The Negev of Judah," or "The Negev of Jerahmeel," or "The Negev of the Kenites."

cards.question: When Achish asks what he raided, David names the peoples he really attacked.
David leaves no man or woman alive to be brought to Gath. He says that otherwise they would ___ him and his men.
After all of David's reports, Achish starts to suspect that David is lying to him.

cards.text: Achish trusts David, thinking, "Since he has made himself an utter stench to his people Israel, he will be my servant forever." Then the Philistines gather their forces for war against Israel.

cards.question: With the Philistines gathering for war against Israel, what does Achish tell David?

answers.text: He and his men will go to battle with Achish
He and his men will stay behind and guard Gath
He and his men must leave Philistine land for now

cards.text: And David answers, "Then you will come to know what your servant can do." Friend, I've read that line TEN times, and I still can't tell you whose side it's promising to help.

cards.question: Achish already thinks David will be his servant forever. Now David says he'll show what he can do. So Achish says he'll make David his ___ for life.

cards.text: We'll stop right there for now, friend. But trust me, this story is NOT done.
